item.title: Olympics highlight Blue Springs curling rink
item.description: When the Kansas City Curling Club opened its facility on Blue Springs’ Outer Road in 2022, giving the group a dedicated ice surface that it didn’t have rent and share with other winter activities, it was in the middle of the Winter Olympic Games in Beijing. Club president DeeAnn Wlodarski said the group experienced a spike in membership after that, and with the Winter Olympics opening in Italy this week, they are hoping for a repeat.
